title: Sharing this application
p1: The tribunal must treat both sides fairly. This means that each party must see or hear what other parties tell the tribunal.
p2: The rules say that that you must share all communication to the tribunal with the respondent, apart from in limited circumstances.
p3: The tribunal might also decide that your communication needs to be shared with some or all claimants in your group claim.
doYouAgree: Do you agree to the tribunal sharing this application to satisfy the rules of procedure?
yesIAgree: Yes, I agree to the tribunal sharing this application to satisfy the Employment Tribunal Rules of Procedure.
noIDoNotAgree: No, I do not agree to the tribunal sharing this application.
youMustTellTheTribunal: You must tell the tribunal why you do not want to share your application. The tribunal will consider your reasons and decide if you should share your application.
tellUsWhy: Tell the tribunal why you do not want to share this with the respondent
